- nlohmann/json v3.11.3: https://github.com/nlohmann/json/tree/v3.11.3 (MIT, `json.LICENSE.MIT`).
- cpp-httplib v0.18.3: https://github.com/yhirose/cpp-httplib/tree/v0.18.3 (MIT, `httplib.LICENSE`).
